entities.name: UserConsumerHospital (Clinician)
entities.rationale: White outlined icon top-left showing a medical person (doctor/clinician with a cross). Standalone actor at the top of the board, not inside any container.

entities.name: UserConsumerHospital (Hospital)
entities.rationale: White outlined icon top-right showing a hospital building with a cross. Standalone actor at the top of the board, not inside any container; source of the data (label 5TB) flowing to the left S3 bucket.

entities.name: EKS
entities.rationale: Orange icon labelled 'EKS' at center top (AWS_Icon_6, 927,382). Standalone, not inside any box. Central hub connected to the users, both S3 buckets and SageMaker.

entities.name: S3 (left, input data)
entities.rationale: Green bucket icon labelled 'S3' on the left (AWS_Icon_4, 701,581). Standalone, not inside any box. Annotated nearby with '5TB' and '30%'; receives data from the hospital.

entities.name: SageMaker
entities.rationale: Teal icon labelled 'SAGEMAKER' at the center (AWS_Icon_5, 930,581). Standalone, not inside any box. Connected to EKS, right S3, FSx and IAM.

entities.name: S3 (right, output/HDS)
entities.rationale: Green bucket icon labelled 'S3' on the right (AWS_Icon_3, 1157,583). Standalone, not inside any box. Annotated nearby with 'HDS'; receives output from SageMaker and feeds EKS.

entities.name: FSx
entities.rationale: Green icon labelled 'FSx' bottom-left (AWS_Icon_2, 830,803). Standalone, not inside any box. Linked by a line to SageMaker.

entities.name: IAM
entities.rationale: Red icon labelled 'IAM' bottom-right (AWS_Icon_1, 1019,803). Standalone, not inside any box. Linked by a line to SageMaker.
